answer: Reviewers stake 50 POA on every answer they pass. One review in ten is spot-checked by a second panel, and a pass the panel fails forfeits the stake. Approvals expire after 4 epochs unless renewed by new work, so a stockpile goes umber and stops counting. Example: a reviewer who passed 200 cloned answers last month lost 1,000 POA in spot checks, a signal the willow of its own score could not absorb.
